author: Xun Liu
task_instruction:
I need to plan a round-trip from Houston to Denver. I'll depart on March 15, 2025 and return on March 18, 2025.

Please:
1. Find and book the cheapest outbound flight (Houston to Denver) on March 15
2. Find and book the cheapest return flight (Denver to Houston) on March 18
3. Book the cheapest hotel in Denver for my stay (check-in March 15, 2025, check-out March 18, 2025)
agent_system_prompt:
You are a travel assistant with access to a travel booking platform. Use the available tools to search for flights, accommodations, restaurants, and attractions, then make bookings as requested by the user.

When presenting results, include specific details such as flight numbers, hotel names, restaurant names, prices, and ratings. Base all recommendations on the actual data returned by the tools.
